{count} 张都已分析过，共 {groups} 组。: All {count} photos are already analyzed: {groups} groups.
按拍摄时间和画面相似度把同一时刻的照片分成组，并给每张评分: Group photos taken at the same moment by capture time and visual similarity, and score each one
按直方图自动设置影调: Set the tone automatically from the histogram
按住 \\ 键可查看整张修图前: Hold \ to see the whole photo before edits
按住 Alt（Option）点击取样，再拖动涂抹。: Alt-click (Option-click) to set the source, then drag to paint.
按住 Option（Alt）点击取样，再在别处涂抹: Option-click (Alt-click) to set the source, then paint elsewhere
把当前照片存为项目: Save the current photos as a project
把画笔调到盖住瞳孔，点击瞳孔。只会去掉明显偏红的像素。: Size the brush to cover the pupil, then click it. Only clearly red pixels are changed.
保留全图（边缘留黑，不放大裁切）: Keep full frame (black edges, no zoom-in crop)
超过 ZIP 的上限（4 GB 或 65535 个文件），请分批导出，或用支持写: This exceeds the ZIP limit (4 GB or 65,535 files). Export in smaller batches, or use a browser that can save to a folder.
打开照片开始修图: Open a photo to start editing
导出已取消：导出时切换了照片: Export canceled: the photo was changed during export
导入打印机或另一台显示器的 ICC 文件。macOS 在 /System/Lib: Import the ICC file of a printer or another display. On macOS they are in /System/Library/ColorSync/Profiles, on Windows in C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\color. Proofing only changes the preview, not the export.
点顶栏的“裁剪”或按 R 编辑裁剪框，拖动框或四角，按 Esc 完成。: Click “Crop” in the top bar or press R to edit the crop box. Drag the box or its corners, and press Esc when done.
点击画面要调的颜色…: Click a color in the photo…
点击画面中要调整的颜色: Click the color you want to adjust
点击画面中应为中性灰或白色的地方: Click an area that should be neutral gray or white
点击曲线加点，拖动调整。双击或拖出框外可删除。: Click the curve to add a point, then drag to adjust. Double-click a point or drag it out of the box to delete it.
点击要去除的斑点或杂物: Click a spot or blemish to remove it
仿制图章：按住 Option（Alt）取样，再涂抹: Clone Stamp: Option-click (Alt-click) to set the source, then paint
还没有项目。新建一个，把一组照片和它们的修图放在一起。: No projects yet. Create one to keep a set of photos and their edits together.
红眼去除：点击瞳孔: Red eye removal: click the pupil
回到这一步之前: Go back to before this step
继续上次的 {count} 张照片: Continue with the {count} photos from last time
界面语言已更改，重新启动后生效: Language changed. Restart to apply it.
镜头库里没有 {lens} 的数据，可用下方滑块手动校正。: The lens database has no data for {lens}. Use the sliders below to correct it manually.
可用 {name} 原文件名、{n} 序号、{date} 日期: Use {name} for the original file name, {n} for a sequence number, {date} for the date
快照保存当前的全部调整，之后随时可以回到这个状态。: A snapshot saves all current adjustments, so you can return to this state at any time.
浏览器读不了这个文件。RAW 请先打开一次，再用它作参考。: The browser can't read this file. For a RAW file, open it once first, then use it as the reference.
没有读取这个文件的权限: No permission to read this file
每组选中最好的一张，淘汰明显失败的；已手动标记的不改: Pick the best photo in each group and reject obvious failures; photos you flagged yourself are left alone
模型文件不存在，请先运行 scripts/fetch-model.sh: Model file not found. Run scripts/fetch-model.sh first.
默认色彩已接近机内 JPEG，无需相机匹配。: The default color is already close to the in-camera JPEG, so no camera match is needed.
目标色域警告（粉色标出无法还原的颜色）: Gamut warning (pink marks colors the profile can't reproduce)
清除这张照片的全部调整: Clear all adjustments on this photo
适合窗口（Z 在适合和 100% 之间切换）: Fit to window (Z toggles between Fit and 100%)
涂抹要调整的区域: Paint over the area to adjust
涂抹要去掉的内容，可以多涂几笔，再点“消除涂抹区域”。: Paint over what you want to remove (several strokes are fine), then click “Remove painted area”.
涂抹要去掉的物体，LaMa 模型补上背景: Paint over an object to remove it; the LaMa model fills in the background
涂抹要消除的物体，然后点“消除”: Paint over the object to remove, then click “Remove”
涂抹以从蒙版中去掉: Paint to remove from the mask
涂抹以复制取样处: Paint to copy from the source
涂抹以加入蒙版: Paint to add to the mask
拖动选择色相和强度，双击复位。: Drag to choose hue and strength; double-click to reset.
拖入的文件里没有可以打开的照片: None of the dropped files are photos that can be opened
拖入一组 RAW、JPEG、PNG 或 HEIC: Drop RAW, JPEG, PNG or HEIC files
未检测到完整人脸，按画面中的肤色处理: No full face detected; working from the skin tones in the photo
文件不存在或已被移动: The file doesn't exist or has been moved
文件没有可用的镜头数据，可用下方滑块手动校正。: The file has no usable lens data. Use the sliders below to correct it manually.
污点修复：点击斑点，自动找周围的纹理盖上: Spot Healing: click a spot to cover it with matching texture from nearby
无法解码这个 RAW 文件：相机型号可能还不支持，或文件已损坏: Couldn't decode this RAW file: the camera may not be supported yet, or the file is damaged
无法识别这个文件的格式，或文件已损坏: Unrecognized file format, or the file is damaged
先按住 Alt（Option）点击要取样的位置。: First Alt-click (Option-click) where you want to sample from.
先按住 Option（Alt）点击要取样的位置: First Option-click (Alt-click) where you want to sample from
先点“智能分组”分析照片。: Click “Smart grouping” first to analyze the photos.
先选中一个画笔或 AI 图层: Select a brush or AI layer first
先在“软打样”里选择一个 ICC 配置: Choose an ICC profile under “Soft Proofing” first
先在“输出”页导入 ICC 配置: Import an ICC profile on the “Output” tab first
项目只记录照片和修图参数，删除项目不会动磁盘上的原图。: A project only records the photos and their edit settings. Deleting a project never touches the originals on disk.
项目只记住是哪些照片；照片本身和修图参数仍在原处。: A project only remembers which photos it holds; the photos and their edit settings stay where they are.
修图前后对比；按住 \\ 看整张修图前: Before/after comparison; hold \ to see the whole photo before edits
选择打印机或显示器配置: Choose a printer or display profile
选中 {picked} 张，淘汰 {rejected} 张。已手动标记的照片没有: Picked {picked}, rejected {rejected}. Photos you flagged yourself were not changed.
已按机内 JPEG 拟合相机色彩。: Camera color fitted to the in-camera JPEG.
用洋红标出配置无法还原的颜色: Mark colors the profile can't reproduce in magenta
有 {count} 张没有读取权限或已移动，重新添加同一文件即可恢复修图。: {count} photos can't be read or have moved. Add the same files again to restore their edits.
预设、粘贴和同步不包括裁剪、旋转等只属于一张照片的设置。: Presets, paste and sync leave out settings that belong to a single photo, such as crop and rotation.
在画面上点一种颜色，只调整与它相近的颜色。: Click a color in the photo to adjust only colors close to it.
在画面上拖出渐变: Drag on the photo to draw a gradient
在画面上拖出渐变方向: Drag on the photo to set the gradient direction
在要调整的地方涂抹: Paint where you want to adjust
在照片列表里按住 ⌘ 或 Shift 多选: Hold ⌘ or Shift in the photo list to select several
这个文件夹里没有可以打开的照片: This folder has no photos that can be opened
这个系统暂时不能打开 HEIC，请先转换为 JPEG: This system can't open HEIC yet. Convert it to JPEG first.
这里接近灰色，请点一处有颜色的地方。: This area is nearly gray. Click somewhere with color.
这里太暗或已过曝，请点一处中性灰。: This area is too dark or blown out. Click a neutral gray.
这里找不到合适的取样，请换个位置: No suitable source found here. Try another spot.
这张图几乎全是纯黑或纯白，无法分析色彩: This image is almost entirely black or white, so its colors can't be analyzed
支持 RAW、JPEG、PNG、TIFF 和 HEIC。照片只在本机处理，原图不: Supports RAW, JPEG, PNG, TIFF and HEIC. Photos are processed only on this computer, and the originals are never modified.
只对打印机等输出配置有效: Only works with output profiles such as printers
只支持 3D LUT，这是 1D LUT: Only 3D LUTs are supported; this is a 1D LUT
只支持定义域为 0–1 的 LUT: Only LUTs with a 0–1 domain are supported
最多 4 个图层。选中线性或径向图层后，可以直接拖动画面上的控制点。: Up to 4 layers. With a linear or radial layer selected, drag its handles directly on the photo.
作用于整张照片，常与亮度或颜色范围一起用: Affects the whole photo; often used with a luminance or color range
G 网格视图，E 单张视图: G grid view, E loupe view
HEIC 文件里没有可解码的图像: The HEIC file has no image that can be decoded
Lensfun 镜头库有 {lens} 的校正数据（CC BY-SA 3.0），: The Lensfun database has correction data for {lens} (CC BY-SA 3.0). Turn on the option above to use it.
LUT 数据不完整：应有 {expected} 行，实际 {actual} 行: Incomplete LUT data: expected {expected} rows, found {actual}
LUT 数据不完整：应有 {size} 行，实际 {count} 行: Incomplete LUT data: expected {size} rows, found {count}
ProPhoto RGB 范围很宽，8 位容易出现色阶断层，建议用 16 位 P: ProPhoto RGB is a very wide gamut, so 8-bit files easily show banding. Use 16-bit PNG or TIFF instead.
把一组照片存为项目，以后一键打开: Save a set of photos as a project to reopen in one click
在画面上拖动以变形: Drag on the photo to warp it
打开 HEIC 需要 libheif，请先安装（例如 sudo apt inst: Opening HEIC needs libheif. Please install it first (for example: sudo apt install libheif1)
自动识别人脸，只处理皮肤，避开眼睛、眉毛和嘴唇。: Finds faces automatically and retouches only skin, leaving eyes, brows and lips alone.
